'''Fush Dueling LSC''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Fush]]
* '''Published:''' 4 December 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Theme/Fun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS7]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif|label=Let Them Make The First Move}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Let Them Make The First Move
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS7 FirstMove Fush DS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Bad Feeling Have I (V), The Emperor (V), Security Precautions (V), Imperial Decree (V), Ability, Ability, Ability (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

This is a fun LSC with dueling instead of lightsaber combat. It's more of an attempt to use LSC as a platform for dueling, than saying that dueling is the best option for LSC. I need some quick comments, please. Also, there's not supposed to be any V8 cards in here.

== Notes ==

* Author: 'there's not supposed to be any V8 cards in here'. Original-era (V): Bad Feeling Have I (V) (VS5); The Emperor (V), Imperial Decree (V), Ability, Ability, Ability (V) (VS6); Security Precautions (V) (VS7).
* Posted 'DVDLOTS' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith. Unique Darth Maul/Vader With Lightsaber x3, Emperor Palpatine x2 and Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba x2 dested as posted.

== Strategy ==

The basic strategy is: deploy, drain, evade and duel. Civil Disorder (V) is a problem. But if I can get the first drains, so that I am ahead in the race, every force he loses to make a combat card lost, is a step closer to victory for me. I really only have two questions for this deck:

1. Should I replace the The Emperor (V) with another regular Palpatine?

2. I'd really like to have Darth Maul (Tatooine version) in here, for extra dueling and Ability x3 (V). Which card should go out?

Thanks for your comments!
